facts.condition: Assuming the binary-alphabet reduction of Marton's private-message objective to randomized time sharing, no two-use construction for the canonical half-skew channel can outperform the established product time-sharing benchmark when its induced distribution on paired channel inputs has support cardinality at most two. Hence any strict improvement within this construction class requires support cardinality of at least three.

assumptions: The binary-input Marton characterization invoked by the accepted claim is valid and applies to each reduced binary-input case arising from the support classification.
The comparison benchmark is the established product randomized-time-sharing construction for the canonical channel.
The two-use channel is the memoryless product of the canonical half-skew BSSC.
